title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide your body with sufficient iron and folate. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of your baby. However, choosing iron- and folate-rich foods can be challenging. Here are three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, helping you have a nutritious and safe meal.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Spinach Bowl with Lemon
* 100g grilled chicken (iron: 1.5mg)
* 100g steamed spinach (iron: 2.5mg, vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 lemon (vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 bowl of white rice

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of heme iron, while steamed spinach provides non-heme iron and vitamin C. Fresh lemon juice helps increase iron absorption. Note: Ensure the chicken is cooked thoroughly to avoid food poisoning.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry Bowl with Bell Pepper
* 100g beef stir-fry (iron: 2.5mg)
* 100g steamed broccoli (iron: 1.5mg, vitamin C: 30mg)
* 1 bell pepper (vitamin C: 100mg)
* 1 bowl of white rice

Beef stir-fry is a rich source of heme iron, while steamed broccoli provides non-heme iron and vitamin C. Bell pepper helps increase iron absorption. Note: Ensure the beef is cooked thoroughly to avoid food poisoning.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Bowl with Kidney Beans and Water Spinach
* 100g cooked kidney beans (iron: 3.5mg)
* 100g steamed water spinach (iron: 2.5mg, vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 lemon (vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 bowl of white rice

Cooked kidney beans are an excellent source of non-heme iron, while steamed water spinach provides non-heme iron and vitamin C. Fresh lemon juice helps increase iron absorption. Note: Ensure the kidney beans are cooked thoroughly to avoid food poisoning.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's crucial to prioritize food safety to avoid the risk of food poisoning. Ensure:
* All meat and seafood are cooked thoroughly
* Avoid eating raw or undercooked food
* Wash all vegetables and fruits before consumption
* Store and cook all food properly

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, helping you have a nutritious and safe meal. Remember to prioritize food safety and ensure all food is cooked thoroughly and stored properly. faqs.question: Why are iron and folate important for pregnant women?
faqs.answer: Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the baby.

faqs.question: How can I increase iron absorption?
faqs.answer: Iron absorption can be increased by consuming foods rich in vitamin C, such as lemon or bell pepper, along with iron-rich foods.

faqs.question: What foods can I eat to provide enough iron and folate for my body?
faqs.answer: You can eat iron-rich foods like meat, seafood, beans, and leafy greens, along with folate-rich foods like spinach, broccoli, and citrus fruits.
